name: hud_sensor_set_save_state_marker_max_distance
description: HudSensorTracker::SetSaveStateMarkerMaxDistance stores the squared marker distance and returns success.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x416ef0 multiplies maxDist by itself, stores the result at saveStateMarkerMaxDistSq, returns 1, and has no direct callees.
Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x416ef0 has no warnings or tags and shows the same squared-distance store.
The native hud_sensor_map_bounds_and_save_state_smoke calls SetSaveStateMarkerMaxDistance and verifies Init restores saveStateMarkerMaxDistSq to 450.0 squared through the same helper.
